key_findings: Electroacupuncture alleviated mechanical allodynia and anxiety-like behaviors in SNI mice and increased activity of rACC glutamatergic and DRN serotonergic neurons, which were both reduced by chronic neuropathic pain.
Chemogenetic activation of the rACCGlu-DRN projection was analgesic and anxiolytic, while its inhibition blocked EA's effects and induced anxiety-like behavior at day 7 after SNI.
